pr_title: Implement ADR 0151 headless MCP writer ownership
pr_body: Repairs the ADR 0151 headless MCP implementation after full Windows Validation exposed non-Clone Graph/GraphView rollback assumptions. Rollback now reloads the canonical saved file after persistence failure, layout mutation borrows the semantic graph without cloning it, and json! is test-only. Re-run full Windows Validation because the PR still changes Cargo.lock/workspace membership.
